description: Turns agent replies into live cards you can use: charts, test runs, decisions, plans and small apps, drawn in your bb theme. Agents pick from 129 components on their own and check each card before you see it, so a status report arrives as metrics and progress, and proof of done as criteria with their evidence. Sliders and toggles recompute cards in place, buttons and pickers send your answer back to the agent (design variants, colors, marks on a screenshot, comments on a spec, a ranked list), and live cards re-read files every 2 seconds while a job runs. Pin a card to keep it live beside the conversation, or open any card in the web playground. Cards also read bb itself: the thread's context use, the threads it started, its pull request, commits, terminals and plan usage. Adds about 3,500 tokens of instructions to each top-level session, and maps and photos call OpenStreetMap, Photon and Wikimedia Commons unless you turn web lookups off.
